title: SR-3.02 An engine conformance suite in the core
request: Closes G31: The service contract in PAID-CONVERGENCE.md has no executable test any engine must pass. Repository: mgillr/memev. Depends on contracts: SR-3.01.

tasks.title: Conformance corpus and runner
requirements: at least 300 three-way cases from real vault edits: disjoint sections, same section different lines, reorder, delete-vs-edit, tables, front matter, CJK
pass means: every non-conflicting change kept, no merge markers, valid Markdown, refuse only on true conflicts
runs any engine command given with --engine

criteria.statement: A stub engine that drops a change fails the suite

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
